title: Heavenly Eye's Warning
next_chapter_hook: When two wills fought for dominance within the same body, Chen Ji chose a third path—to overturn the entire chessboard, along with the one who played the game.

text.content: The moment the golden light surged, the fragment in Chen Ji's embrace trembled violently, as if awakened by some force. That familiar Heavenly Secrets power flooded through his entire body, yet it was not his own doing—the fragment itself was sounding the alarm. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, realizing a terrifying possibility: the danger the Heavenly Eye warned of was never directed outward, but at this forbidden object in his arms that could ignite chaos across the world.

dialogue.content: "It is awakening." The Heavenly Eye's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, each word like thunder, "The page within you is about to break free from slumber. The Fate Chronicler has been waiting for this moment—he intends to use your body to fully reunite the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the tumultuous waves in his heart, his expression betraying nothing. He slowly raised his head, his gaze passing through the Fate Chronicler's phantom to his own chest—where a faint light distinctly different from the fragment was emerging. He should have realized long ago: if the Tianji Record could be split into multiple pages, there would inevitably come a day when it would reunite. And he, the bearer, had been the Fate Chronicler's chosen vessel from the very start.

dialogue.content: "So, were you using me from the beginning?" Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, as if discussing something utterly unrelated to him, "From the moment I picked up the fragment, was I already a piece on your game board?"

"Not just him." The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly dropped to a low murmur, "Even I... am also a piece of a higher existence. The Universe's Will is not the only one—above it, there is..." Before it could finish, the golden light suddenly stagnated, as if some force was forcibly suppressing the Heavenly Eye's awakening.

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. Was the Heavenly Eye not the end? Could that so-called higher existence be—the Heavenly Dao Source mentioned in Volume Eight? Just as he was about to ask further, the Fate Chronicler's phantom suddenly solidified, and a meaningful smile appeared on that face woven from golden light patterns.

dialogue.content: "There are many things it didn't tell you." The Fate Chronicler's voice was like an ancient bell, making Chen Ji's eardrums ache, "The Heavenly Eye is merely the eye of Heavenly Dao, and the Heavenly Dao Source... is the hand that truly controls everything. You think you're scheming for the world, but you were never aware that from the moment you were born, your fate has already been written."

text.content: The golden phantom slowly drifted closer to Chen Ji, and that vast, ocean-like pressure made his breathing difficult. But Chen Ji still stood upright, even a faint, barely perceptible smile curving at the corner of his lips. He remembered what Mo Xiansheng once said: the Tianji Record is a piece arranged by Heavenly Dao. Then what about the Fate Chronicler and the Heavenly Eye?

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's voice came from the distance, carrying irrepressible anxiety. She sensed that terrifying aura and rushed toward this place without hesitation, "Whatever they say, don't trust them lightly!"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't look back, but his heart inexplicably calmed. He slowly spoke, his voice not loud, yet clearly transmitting into the ears of both consciousnesses: "Elders, your argument is quite splendid, but this junior has a question—if you both need me so much, why not directly tell me the truth, but instead make me guess myself?"

dialogue.content: "Because some truths..." The Heavenly Eye's voice labored to squeeze out each word, "The more you know, the faster you die."

"Is the elder concerned about me?" Chen Ji chuckled lightly, yet there was not a trace of warmth in that smile, "Or are you afraid that if I die too quickly, I won't be able to help you achieve your purpose?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a decision that surprised both parties—

choices.description: Although the Heavenly Eye is also a pawn, it at least gave substantive warnings. Perhaps it knows more about the Heavenly Dao Source's intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: May offend the Fate Chronicler and lose partial Tianji Record support
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence from the Heavenly Eye and temporarily delay the fragment's awakening within the body
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye is not entirely trustworthy, its motives are still unclear

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes and delved his consciousness into the space resonating with the Tianji Record. The Heavenly Eye's core was like a burning golden star, emitting a faint yet steadfast light. "Tell me," he silently thought, "What exactly is the Heavenly Dao Source?"

choices.description: The Fate Chronicler controls the core of the Tianji Record. Its answers may be closer to the truth, even if they might also be another form of manipulation.
choices.visible_cost: May become the complete puppet of the Fate Chronicler
choices.visible_reward: Have the opportunity to obtain the complete Tianji Record and uncover secrets of a higher level
choices.risk_hint: Once completely controlled, will completely lose autonomous consciousness

text.content: Chen Ji turned to the Fate Chronicler's phantom, his expression calm to the point of coldness: "Since the elder says the Tianji Record is a game you arranged, I would like to know—what is your purpose in arranging this game?"

choices.description: Both sides are chess players. Why should he take sides? He intends to simultaneously use information from both parties to weave a chess game that belongs only to him.
choices.visible_cost: May anger both parties simultaneously and lose protection
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the greatest autonomy, obtain intelligence from both parties, and wait for an opportunity to counter
choices.risk_hint: Displeasing both sides, must bear the consequences alone

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a kind of composure that saw through everything: "Both elders make compelling points. But this junior wants to ask—in your argument, must I choose between you?" He slowly swept his gaze across the two phantoms, "Can't I... use you both simultaneously?"

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye says you want to use my body to reunite," Chen Ji's eyes gleamed with dangerous light, "You say there is a Source above the Heavenly Eye. So let me ask—if I want intelligence from both sides and utilize the scheming of both, what would happen in the end?"

"You don't know you're playing with fire." The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, "Using both sides simultaneously will only cause both parties to regard you as a threat simultaneously. You will die faster than with any other choice."

"Is that so?" Chen Ji's voice was light, yet carried a terrifying confidence, "But I remember a saying—advance from certain death. Since death is inevitable either way, why don't I bet on something big?"

text.content: Just then, Su Qingyao finally arrived. The moment she saw Chen Ji simultaneously confronting two supreme existences, her face instantly turned ashen. But she did not retreat. Instead, she stood unhesitantly at Chen Ji's side, the sword in her hand already drawn, its tip pointing directly at the Fate Chronicler's phantom.

dialogue.content: "Whatever you are," Su Qingyao's voice was cold yet firm, "If you want to touch him, you must get past me first."

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at her sideways, and an indescribable emotion surged in his heart. This woman, time and again approached the truth, yet was cleverly deflected by him; now she was willing to fight against the will of Heavenly Dao for him... He silently recorded in his heart: this kindness, he would definitely repay in the future.

dialogue.content: "Qingyao, you shouldn't have come." Chen Ji said softly, yet had no intention of letting her leave, "Since you're here, accompany me to watch this good show."

text.content: He turned back to the two phantoms, a meaningful smile curving at the corner of his lips: "Elders, you see, isn't there now a third path? I am not walking this road alone." His voice gradually turned cold, "So, will you two continue to hide and hold back? Or do you actually fear... a waste who has someone to protect him?"
